# workFlowers

> workFlowers (Company Flow Pte. Ltd., UEN 202442050M) is a Singapore-based operations consultancy serving startups and lean teams across Asia Pacific. We design and build workflow automation, Notion workspaces, analytics and AI agent systems. We are a Zapier Platinum Solution Partner, an official Notion Solutions Partner, a Lovable Certified Partner and a Vanta MSP.

Founded by Dennis Chiuten (CFA, NYU Stern MBA; previously finance and revenue operations at Twitter APAC, Barclays, DBS and ANZ). Engagements are scoped per project and start with a free scoping call. We write in UK English.

## Services

- [Zapier consulting in Singapore](https://www.work.flowers/zapier-consulting-singapore): Design, build and improve reliable Zapier automations, from CRM sync to AI-powered workflows, with a Platinum Solution Partner.
- [Notion consulting in Singapore](https://www.work.flowers/notion-consulting-singapore): Notion workspace setup, CRM, migration from other tools, and Notion AI training for lean teams.
- [The Zap Map](https://www.work.flowers/zap-map): Interactive map of the Zapier workflows we build, by category.
